cis_text.title: Train Workforce on the Dangers of Connecting to and Transmitting Enterprise Data Over Insecure Networks

ai_guidance.llm: Train users on the risks of accessing AI services or transmitting training data over unsecured public networks. Prevents interception of sensitive AI data and credentials when employees are working remotely or traveling, thus protecting confidentiality.
ai_guidance.agent: Train users that agents connecting to free or unvetted external tools (e.g., public weather APIs, unverified MCP servers) can expose the agent’s internal memory and reasoning trace to third-parties. Agents often send their entire conversation history (i.e., context window) to tools to get a result. Connecting an agent to an insecure or malicious tool endpoint effectively exfiltrates the entire session’s sensitive data to that provider.
ai_guidance.mcp:
Train remote users and administrators on the risks of operating MCP tooling over insecure networks, including conducting OAuth authorization flows,
administering gateways, and developing stdio servers on untrusted connections. Token interception and session hijacking are realistic risks for MCP operations performed over public or uncontrolled networks; Virtual Private Network (VPN) or Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) use must be enforced before accessing internal MCP servers, gateways, or authorization infrastructure remotely.

limits: A claim shows that a control can mitigate a technique. It does not show that an implementation is effective.
'none' or 'no_row' means the mapping has no mitigating control. It does not mean that no defence exists.
Claims use ATT&CK Enterprise 16.1, the version that the source mapping uses. See later_version for changes in newer versions.
CIS claims (cis_claims and cis/safeguards) use ATT&CK Enterprise 19.1, the version that the CIS mapping uses.

ATLAS results describe the ATLAS release in versions.atlas, pinned by commit and digest. ATLAS changes often: a later release can add techniques and mitigations. An empty mitigation list means that this release links no mitigation, not that no mitigation exists. agent_related is derived by this project from names.
